tables.name: rfc_hierarchy_edges
columns: rfc_hierarchy_edge_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
parent_rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
child_rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
edge_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(edge_state IN ('active','superseded'))
opened_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(opened_at_utc>=0)
closed_at_utc INTEGER
opened_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
closed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK(parent_rfc_id<>child_rfc_id)
CHECK((edge_state='active' AND closed_at_utc IS NULL AND closed_command_id IS NULL) OR (edge_state='superseded' AND closed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND closed_command_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: partial unique index gives each child at most one active parent
insert guard rejects parent that is itself an active child and rejects child that currently has active children, which enforces two levels and prevents cycles
hierarchy role is always derived from active edges
reparent supersedes old edge and inserts a new edge atomically; old edge is immutable history

tables.name: sr_rfc_links
tables.purpose: direct history-preserving SR relationship to root/master RFC only
columns: sr_rfc_link_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
service_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
link_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(link_state IN ('active','unlinked'))
opened_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(opened_at_utc>=0)
closed_at_utc INTEGER
opened_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
closed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
reason_category TEXT
CHECK((link_state='active' AND closed_at_utc IS NULL AND closed_command_id IS NULL) OR (link_state='unlinked' AND closed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND closed_command_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: active direct link is permitted only when rfc_id is currently parentless/root
duplicate active link is semantic NO_CHANGE
unlink of already-absent relation is semantic NO_CHANGE
unlink never changes SR/RFC lifecycle and never deletes prior link history
a hierarchy mutation that would make an RFC subordinate is blocked while that RFC has active direct SR links unless an explicit reviewed relationship correction resolves them first

tables.name: rfc_device_reference_links
columns: rfc_device_reference_link_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
device_reference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES device_references(device_reference_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
link_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(link_state IN ('active','unlinked'))
opened_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(opened_at_utc>=0)
closed_at_utc INTEGER
opened_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
closed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK((link_state='active' AND closed_at_utc IS NULL AND closed_command_id IS NULL) OR (link_state='unlinked' AND closed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND closed_command_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: RFC may have Device References with or without any SR relationship
subordinate-specific Device References are independent from the master's set
Network Element resolution never rewrites this FK or link identity

tables.name: sr_device_reference_links
columns: sr_device_reference_link_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY

link_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(link_state IN ('active','unlinked'))
opened_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(opened_at_utc>=0)
closed_at_utc INTEGER
opened_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
closed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK((link_state='active' AND closed_at_utc IS NULL AND closed_command_id IS NULL) OR (link_state='unlinked' AND closed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND closed_command_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: SR operational device context targets Device Reference, not Network Element

database_guards: BEFORE INSERT active rfc_hierarchy_edge rejects parent already appearing as active child
BEFORE INSERT active rfc_hierarchy_edge rejects child already appearing as active parent
BEFORE INSERT active rfc_hierarchy_edge rejects child with active direct sr_rfc_links
BEFORE INSERT active sr_rfc_link rejects rfc_id appearing as active hierarchy child
BEFORE UPDATE of active hierarchy/link rows permits only governed active-to-terminal transition fields; historical rows reject further UPDATE
BEFORE DELETE on hierarchy/link history raises append-only protection
index_rule: Full-history FK indexes are distinct from active-only operational indexes. Partial active indexes cannot satisfy LLD-01 FK child-index coverage for historical rows.
dependency: device_references table is defined separately in schema/device-references.json after exact descriptive/matching authority is pinned; relationship FKs are part of the accepted LLD-03 schema set and migrations are published only when the complete set resolves.
